question: The sum of and difference between the LCM and HCF of two numbers are 512 and 496, respectively. If one number is 72, then the other number is:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

LCM = (Sum + Difference) ÷ 2 = (512 + 496) ÷ 2 = 504

HCF = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2 = (512 − 496) ÷ 2 = 8

Property: Product of Numbers = LCM × HCF

72 × Second Number = 504 × 8

Second Number = (504 × 8) ÷ 72 = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of LCM and HCF = 512

Difference of LCM and HCF = 496

First Number (N₁) = 72

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19a4b05d72770be6f43beabd5fcfc10e46ed6e082a5ac6a41f18457fa5575123.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let LCM be L and HCF be H.

⇒ L + H = 512 --- (i)

⇒ L − H = 496 --- (ii)

⇒ Adding (i) and (ii): 2L = 1008 ⇒ L = 504

⇒ Subtracting (ii) from (i): 2H = 16 ⇒ H = 8

⇒ N₁ × N₂ = L × H

⇒ 72 × N₂ = 504 × 8

⇒ N₂ = (504 × 8) ÷ 72

⇒ N₂ = 4032 ÷ 72 = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relationship between Numbers and their LCM/HCF

The product of any two numbers is always equal to the product of their LCM and HCF. Formula: N₁ × N₂ = LCM × HCF.

HCF as a Factor

The HCF of any group of numbers is always a factor of their LCM. This means LCM ÷ HCF will always result in an integer.

HCF of Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is 1. In such cases, their LCM is simply the product of the two numbers.</p
